description: Implementation of a network link receiver that creates, binds, listens on sockets, and manages connections using SbSocketWaiter, including threading and socket event handling.

classes.name: LinkReceiver::Impl
classes.description: Private implementation class managing socket server, connections, threading, and event handling for link reception.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::Run
methods.description: Initializes socket, binds, listens, and runs the main event loop.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::AddForAccept
methods.description: Adds listening socket to SbSocketWaiter for accept events.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::AddForRead
methods.description: Adds a connection socket to SbSocketWaiter for read events.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::OnAcceptReady
methods.description: Handles new incoming connection, accepts socket, and adds it for reading.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::OnReadReady
methods.description: Handles socket data ready to read, processes data, and manages connection lifecycle.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::RunThread
methods.description: Thread entry point that runs the server loop.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::HandleAccept
methods.description: Static callback for accept events from SbSocketWaiter.

methods.name: LinkReceiver::Impl::HandleRead
methods.description: Static callback for read events from SbSocketWaiter.
